---
description: Visually review the current browser preview, test it, and iterate until it looks and works correctly
---

Screenshot the implementation in the preview. Fix any issues. Screenshot again. Verify all is working correctly. Continue until completion.

# Additional Details
After implementing any UI change, visual component, or Storybook story: open the relevant browser page or story, take a screenshot, inspect it for issues (wrong colors, invisible elements, layout breaks, errors), fix any problems found, and screenshot again to confirm. Repeat until the output looks correct. Do not consider a task done until you have visually confirmed it works.
